Estonia · Brief drone incursions over the Gulf of Finland

11 November 2026 · Estonia · Brief drone incursions over the Gulf of Finland

Officially reported brief drone incursions; exact number unresolved

In an ERR interview, the defence minister distinguished brief Gulf of Finland airspace violations from a separate drone entering from Latvia at approximately 03:30. Estonia's government separately confirmed that some drones briefly entered national airspace that night.

NATO fighters were airborne. The minister said safe destruction conditions were not available, including proximity to the Russian border.

Exact drone count, crossing times and tracks unresolved. Reported Ukrainian attribution is the minister's account, not independent confirmation. No confirmed attack on Estonia, crash, recovery or shoot-down. No proven link to the suspected Finnish crossing.
